## How to watch the iPhone 18 event

Apple's event kicks off Wednesday, Sept. 9, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. PT / 1:00 p.m. ET at the Steve Jobs Theater at Apple Park, with a livestream on Apple's website and YouTube channel for those not attending in person.

Mashable will be there on the ground, so look out for our coverage and hands-on impressions once the keynote wraps.

Apple's September event will take place on Wednesday, September 9 at 10:00 a.m. Pacific Time. Apple will announce its 2026 iPhone lineup, and this year is a big one. Along with the slab-style iPhones we've been using for years, Apple is going to debut its first foldable device. We'll also get new Apple Watches, a new set of AirPods, and possibly some other surprises.

Apple announced that theiPhone 18 event will take place on September 9, and we already have a good idea of what to expect thanks to tons of rumors and leaks. A folding iPhone — potentially to be called the iPhone Ultra — is widely expected to launch alongside the iPhone 18 lineup. We've even seen some recent hints in the new iOS 27 beta software that point even more in that direction.
